scope: Persisted sandbox analysis-run errors returned by AnalysisEnvironment.list_runs

behavior.run_history: A non-empty stored error_message is replaced with [details redacted].
behavior.preserved_metadata: Run identity, module, status, timestamps, duration, and error presence remain available.

coverage: synthetic sandbox diagnostic text is absent from run history
failed status and duration remain visible

database_or_provider_access: none; synthetic row and fake connection only
limitations: No live database or sandbox execution was accessed.
This redacts diagnostics on the history read path; it does not change sandbox execution or retention.
